Tour

Source: vignettes/articles/components/tour.Rmd
tour.Rmd

A popup component for guiding users through a product. Use when you want to guide users through a product.

Basic usage

The most basic usage

A step’s target is a CSS selector. The tour’s visible and current follow a store, [v_model()]: the button starts it in the browser, and finishing or closing it sets the store back. From the server it is update_el_tour(visible = TRUE, current = 0).

vue_store("tour_basic", state = list(open = FALSE, current = 0))
el_button(
  "begin",
  "Begin Tour",
  type = "primary",
  on = list(
    click = "$vueStore.tour_basic.current = 0; $vueStore.tour_basic.open = true"
  )
)
el_divider()
el_space(
  tags$span(id = "t_up", el_button("up", "Upload")),
  tags$span(id = "t_save", el_button("save", "Save", type = "primary")),
  tags$span(id = "t_more", el_button("more", "", icon = "MoreFilled"))
)
el_tour(
  "tour",
  visible = v_model("$vueStore.tour_basic.open"),
  current = v_model("$vueStore.tour_basic.current"),
  steps = list(
    el_tour_step("#t_up", "Upload File", "Put you files here."),
    el_tour_step("#t_save", "Save", "Save your changes"),
    el_tour_step("#t_more", "Other Actions", "Click to see other")
  )
)

Non modal

Use :mask="false" to make Tour non-modal. At the meantime it is recommended to use with type="primary" to emphasize the guide itself.

mask = FALSE leaves the page undimmed; type = "primary" colours the card.

vue_store("tour_non_modal", state = list(open = FALSE, current = 0))
el_button(
  "begin",
  "Begin Tour",
  type = "primary",
  on = list(
    click = "$vueStore.tour_non_modal.current = 0; $vueStore.tour_non_modal.open = true"
  )
)
el_divider()
el_space(
  tags$span(id = "t_up", el_button("up", "Upload")),
  tags$span(id = "t_save", el_button("save", "Save", type = "primary")),
  tags$span(id = "t_more", el_button("more", "", icon = "MoreFilled"))
)
el_tour(
  "tour",
  visible = v_model("$vueStore.tour_non_modal.open"),
  current = v_model("$vueStore.tour_non_modal.current"),
  type = "primary",
  mask = FALSE,
  steps = list(
    el_tour_step("#t_up", "Upload File", "Put you files here."),
    el_tour_step("#t_save", "Save", "Save your changes"),
    el_tour_step("#t_more", "Other Actions", "Click to see other")
  )
)

Placement

Change the placement of the guide relative to the target, there are 12 placements available. When target is empty the guide will show in the center.

vue_store("tour_placement", state = list(open = FALSE, current = 0))
tags$span(
  id = "t_btn",
  el_button(
    "begin",
    "Begin Tour",
    type = "primary",
    on = list(
      click = "$vueStore.tour_placement.current = 0; $vueStore.tour_placement.open = true"
    )
  )
)
el_tour(
  "tour",
  visible = v_model("$vueStore.tour_placement.open"),
  current = v_model("$vueStore.tour_placement.current"),
  steps = list(
    el_tour_step(
      title = "Center",
      description = "Displayed in the center of screen."
    ),
    el_tour_step(
      "#t_btn",
      "Right",
      "On the right of target.",
      placement = "right"
    ),
    el_tour_step("#t_btn", "Top", "On the top of target.", placement = "top")
  )
)

Custom mask style

Custom mask style.

mask takes Element Plus’s object: its style and color.

vue_store("tour_mask", state = list(open = FALSE, current = 0))
el_button(
  "begin",
  "Begin Tour",
  type = "primary",
  on = list(
    click = "$vueStore.tour_mask.current = 0; $vueStore.tour_mask.open = true"
  )
)
el_divider()
el_space(
  tags$span(id = "t_up", el_button("up", "Upload")),
  tags$span(id = "t_save", el_button("save", "Save", type = "primary"))
)
el_tour(
  "tour",
  visible = v_model("$vueStore.tour_mask.open"),
  current = v_model("$vueStore.tour_mask.current"),
  mask = list(
    style = list(boxShadow = "inset 0 0 15px #333"),
    color = "rgba(80, 255, 255, .4)"
  ),
  steps = list(
    el_tour_step("#t_up", "Upload File", "Put you files here."),
    el_tour_step(
      "#t_save",
      "Save",
      "Save your changes",
      mask = list(
        style = list(boxShadow = "inset 0 0 15px #fff"),
        color = "rgba(40, 0, 255, .4)"
      )
    )
  )
)

Custom indicator

Custom indicator.

The indicators slot draws the step counter; its scope is current and total.

vue_store("tour_indicator", state = list(open = FALSE, current = 0))
el_button(
  "begin",
  "Begin Tour",
  type = "primary",
  on = list(
    click = "$vueStore.tour_indicator.current = 0; $vueStore.tour_indicator.open = true"
  )
)
el_divider()
el_space(
  tags$span(id = "t_up", el_button("up", "Upload")),
  tags$span(id = "t_save", el_button("save", "Save", type = "primary"))
)
el_tour(
  "tour",
  visible = v_model("$vueStore.tour_indicator.open"),
  current = v_model("$vueStore.tour_indicator.current"),
  steps = list(
    el_tour_step("#t_up", "Upload File", "Put you files here."),
    el_tour_step("#t_save", "Save", "Save your changes")
  ),
  slots = list(
    indicators = template(
      tags$span("{{ current + 1 }} / {{ total }}"),
      slot = "indicators",
      scope = "{ current, total }"
    )
  )
)

Target

Various parameter passing types of target. The string and Function types are supported since 2.5.2.

A target may be any selector, and need not exist until the step is shown.

vue_store("tour_target", state = list(open = FALSE, current = 0))
el_button(
  "begin",
  "Begin Tour",
  type = "primary",
  on = list(
    click = "$vueStore.tour_target.current = 0; $vueStore.tour_target.open = true"
  )
)
el_divider()
tags$div(
  id = "first",
  style = "display: inline-block; padding: 8px; border: 1px dashed #ccc",
  "First"
)
tags$div(
  class = "second",
  style = "display: inline-block; padding: 8px; border: 1px dashed #ccc",
  "Second"
)
el_tour(
  "tour",
  visible = v_model("$vueStore.tour_target.open"),
  current = v_model("$vueStore.tour_target.current"),
  steps = list(
    el_tour_step("#first", "By id", "A selector for an id."),
    el_tour_step(".second", "By class", "A selector for a class.")
  )
)
First
Second

Tour Attributes

Element In R Description Type Accepted Default

show-arrow show_arrow whether to show the arrow boolean true
placement placement position of the guide card relative to the target element 3'top' \\| 'top-start' \\| 'top-end' \\| 'bottom' \\| 'bottom-start' \\| 'bottom-end' \\| 'left' \\| 'left-start' \\| 'left-end' \\| 'right' \\| 'right-start' \\| 'right-end' bottom

type type type, affects the background color and text color default \ primary
model-value visible; input$<id> open tour boolean false
current current what is the current step number 0
scroll-into-view-options scroll_into_view_options support pass custom scrollIntoView options boolean \ ScrollIntoViewOptions
z-index z_index Tour’s zIndex number 2001
show-close show_close whether to show a close button boolean true
close-icon close_icon custom close icon, default is Close string \ Component
